title: A fresh seat (signed in, no account record or site yet) loads /new/ and Help's restore answers an empty conversation, not 401
steps: S1: Mint a tracy_sess cookie for a never-seen address reg1085-<ms>@example.test with the stand's SESSION_SECRET.

S3: In a new browser context carrying the cookie, open $O/new/ and record the status of every response whose path is /api/assistant/conversation, waiting for the first one (<= 120 s) and 5 s after it.
expect: S2 answers HTTP 200 with conversationId null and turns [].
The page calls /api/assistant/conversation at least once and every call answers below 400 (before the fix: 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN on every load).
evidence: 09/10/2026 on the private stand tracy-srd and on dsh-passwords 2.7.7-tracy.5: every /new/ load by a fresh seat logged a 401 on /api/assistant/conversation. Cause: signedIn() in assistant/route.js answered NOT_SIGNED_IN when the signed session's email had no account row.
fence: The real tracy-web door and the real /new/ page of the stand. A real email-code sign-in creates the account row first, so this guards a signed session the account book does not know yet (minted sessions, any future door that signs in before writing the row).
